central_claim: Across neighboring Antarctic breeding islands, Adelie populations share an exceptionally strong long-term decline but differ in annual dynamics and extinction, while a modest local resilience signal resides in the distribution of breeders among subcolonies rather than in the tested simple sea-ice-duration, snowfall, or large-group-retention formulations.

external spatial/topographic validation under a new pre-outcome contract
